# Order API notes

**Provenance: [V] throughout.** Read against the vendored schema.

## 1. Refunds

The API has no partial-refund support. The `refund` object takes a boolean.

## 2. Idempotency

`order.json` carries an `idempotency_key`, so retries are safe.

## 3. Naming

The team calls these "tickets" internally, which is confusing.
